## MomentKH

MIT-licensed Khmer lunar calendar engine by ThyrithSor, package version 3.0.3.
Source: https://github.com/ThyrithSor/momentkh/tree/ff2bfd558385bd5403780b671fd2eca43b3e2228
Upstream TypeScript blob: 12515b69d5fc023ad7ee924b47650ab95bda35b5

`momentkh.js` is the upstream `momentkh.ts` transpiled to ES2022 ES modules with TypeScript; no algorithm changes. Types are upstream's `dist/momentkh.d.ts`. The full license is in `momentkh.LICENSE`, and a license banner is included in the JavaScript.

Bundled locally because the package registry was unavailable during implementation. It has no runtime dependencies and makes no network requests. Keep this pinned engine and its attribution together when updating; rerun the independent fixtures in `tests/khmer-calendar.test.ts`.
